key.name: center-enabled
key.summary: Show the centre island (replaces the clock)

key.name: stats-enabled
key.summary: Show the statistics island (top left, replaces the Activities button)

key.name: layout-version
key.summary: Internal: settings layout version (used to migrate saved module lists)

key.name: shortcut-search
key.summary: Shortcut that opens search in the centre island

key.name: shortcut-qs
key.summary: GNOME's Quick Settings shortcut (Super+A) opens the right island instead of the GNOME menu

key.name: qs-enabled
key.summary: Show the Quick Settings island (top right)

key.name: expand-on-hover
key.summary: Expand when the pointer is over the island

key.name: hover-expand-delay
key.summary: Wait before expanding on hover (ms)

key.name: leave-collapse-delay
key.summary: Wait before collapsing after the pointer leaves (ms)

key.name: auto-collapse
key.summary: Collapse after this long without the pointer (ms, 0 = never)

key.name: osd-enabled
key.summary: Show volume / brightness changes in the centre island instead of GNOME's OSD

key.name: notification-preview
key.summary: Preview new notifications in the centre island instead of GNOME's banner

key.name: music-popup
key.summary: Show a short "now playing" preview in the centre island when the track changes

key.name: screenshot-preview
key.summary: Show a thumbnail of new screenshots in the centre island (needs notification-preview)

key.name: notification-duration
key.summary: How long a notification preview stays (ms)

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Expand animation length (ms)

key.name: morph-blur
key.summary: Blur the content while an island opens or closes (iOS-like)

key.name: spring
key.summary: Springy overshoot when expanding

key.name: poll-compact
key.summary: Refresh interval while compact (ms)

key.name: poll-expanded
key.summary: Refresh interval while expanded (ms)

key.name: center-compact-modules
key.summary: Modules shown next to the clock in the panel

key.name: center-modules
key.summary: Content of the expanded centre island, in order

key.name: claude-notify
key.summary: Show Claude Code notifications (finished / waiting) in the centre island; needs `di-config claude-hooks install`

key.name: claude-real-usage
key.summary: Claude card shows the real plan quota from Anthropic (same as /usage): reads Claude Code's login token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json and sends it only to api.anthropic.com

key.name: claude-quota-alerts
key.summary: Warn once at 80 % and 95 % of the Claude 5-hour / weekly quota (needs claude-real-usage)

key.name: claude-permission-buttons
key.summary: Answer Claude Code permission requests with Allow / Deny buttons in the centre island (mouse click only; needs the PermissionRequest hook: di-config claude-hooks install)

key.name: claude-token-limit
key.summary: Claude Code tokens (in thousands) per 5-hour session, used to show how much is left; 0 = just show the tokens used

key.name: stats-modules
key.summary: Content of the expanded statistics island

key.name: stats-compact-modules
key.summary: Metrics shown in the statistics pill in the panel (disk shows up only during heavy disk activity)

key.name: events
key.summary: Events that briefly open the centre island

key.name: qs-modules
key.summary: Sections of the Quick Settings island, top to bottom

key.name: language
key.summary: Interface language (does not follow the system locale)

key.name: theme
key.summary: Colour theme (island body, outline and default accent)

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Accent colour override (#rrggbb); empty = use the theme's accent

key.name: clipboard-history
key.summary: Keep the last 10 copies (in memory only) and show them in the right island

key.name: meeting-mode
key.summary: Turn Do Not Disturb on while the microphone or camera is in use

key.name: meeting-dnd-active
key.summary: Internal: Do Not Disturb was switched on by meeting mode (so it can be undone)

key.name: auto-power-saver
key.summary: Switch to the Power Saver profile when the battery is low

key.name: auto-power-saver-level
key.summary: Battery percentage at or below which Power Saver is requested

key.name: show-seconds
key.summary: Show seconds in the island clock
